events.text: It wakes all at once, like the sun coming up under the clouds. People, beasts, the breath in your own body, the next move of every one of them: all of it, and too much of it.

events.text: A blind archivist of the Jade Court stops you on the long stair and puts a cold thumb on your brow without asking. "Dimmed," she says. "I have a little Moon-Well Dew left from the last gathering. It is not for sale. It is for work."

effects.log: A season of copying slips in the dark of the archive. At the end of it she tips your head back and lets one drop fall.
"It will not get better by itself," she calls after you.

events.text: The cranes say there is a well on the far side of the Isles where the moon sits in the water at noon, and that its dew has closed eyes older than yours.

choices.text: Cross the Isles to the well

effects.log: It is a long, cold crossing, and the well is exactly as the cranes said.
It is only a story. Your eye aches all the way home.

events.text: A hermit on a nameless isle has heard what was taken from you, years ago and far below. There is a cave under the isle, the hermit says, where a stolen root can grow back if its owner will sit through the dark.

effects.log: You go down.
You will go when you are stronger.

choices.text: You have made your peace with the hollow

effects.log: You thank the hermit and do not go.

events.text: The sea of clouds is unusually rich this year, and the hollow where your root used to be has begun to ache like a healing bone. A healer of the Nine Clouds Palace says it is trying to come back.

effects.log: You lie down for the long fever and let it try.

choices.text: Ask the healer to quiet it for now

effects.log: The healer quiets it. It is only sleeping.

choices.text: Ask the healer to quiet it for good

effects.log: The healer does, and the ache goes, and the hope with it.

events.text: A pack of cloud-grey wolves lives on the windward isle, and the youngest has followed you along the rail for three days, never close, never gone.

choices.text: Try to tame it: slowly, your energy held low

effects.log: You sit down on the cloud-grass and wait, and hold out your hand.
You go around it. It watches you go.

events.text: The storm hawk, a crag eagle of the high isles, is down on the rock with one wing spread wide, and it will not fly again today.

choices.text: End it, and take what it leaves

effects.log: You end it quickly and cleanly, as a hunter of the Isles should.
You lay a hand on it and push your energy into it, and do not let go.
You lower your weapon and step back to the edge of the isle.
